_comment: Every dataset used by Ghost Drains. Pipeline refuses to run if checksums differ. See docs/DATA_SOURCES.md.

datasets.name: Copernicus GLO-30 tiles covering study bbox
datasets.license: Copernicus licence; free, attribution if adapted
datasets.attribution: Produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018
datasets.notes: Surface model (includes buildings/trees). Tiles dem_n12_e077.tif and dem_n13_e077.tif.

datasets.name: FABDEM v1-2 tiles covering study bbox
datasets.attribution: FABDEM © University of Bristol / Fathom; derived from Copernicus WorldDEM-30
datasets.notes: Bare-earth candidate. Download location and version to confirm [U].

datasets.name: Bengaluru Stormwater Drains Maps (primary, secondary, tertiary, combined, 2022)
datasets.license: Other (Public Domain) per portal label; original publisher terms unconfirmed [U]
datasets.attribution: Bengaluru Stormwater Drains Maps © KSRSAC via OpenCity.in
datasets.notes: KML format. Includes primary_swd.kml, secondary_swd.kml, tertiary_swd.kml.

datasets.name: OpenStreetMap Bengaluru extract (lakes, waterways, roads, buildings)
datasets.notes: Overpass API extract. Tag coverage for drains/lakes in Bengaluru unknown [U].

datasets.name: Mapterhorn terrain tiles (spike S1 only)
datasets.license: BSD-3 code; data from Copernicus GLO-30
datasets.notes: Terrarium-encoded WebP PMTiles. Used for spike terrain only, not analysis.

datasets.name: EOX Sentinel-2 cloudless imagery
datasets.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (2018-2025 data); CC BY 4.0 (2016 data)
datasets.attribution: Sentinel-2 cloudless https://s2maps.eu by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [YEAR])
datasets.notes: Non-commercial use only. Year-specific attribution required.

datasets.name: Reported flood sites, 4-6 Sept 2022
datasets.notes: Geocode each site from OSM. Selection bias: mostly roads and apartments.
